name: Navigation test: open model settings
goal: Verify the user can navigate from the home screen into the model settings modal.
steps: Confirm the model picker is visible.
expected_result: The settings modal opens and presents model choices for General, Food, and Travel.
success_criteria: The modal contains a Model label.
The picker exposes General, Food, and Travel options.
The app remains on the same QA flow without crash.

ground_truth.rationale: The SettingsButton toggles SettingsModal, and the modal renders a model picker with General, Food, and Travel options.
